Shri Apoorv Joshi, Govt. Advocate for the respondent/
 Shri Subodh Choudhary, Advocate for the respondent [O
 Order

This first application has been filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.230/2025 registered at Police Station-Nagda, District- Ujjain (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 296, 115(2), 351(2), 333, 308(2), 3(5) and 331(6) of BNS, 2023.
Applicant is in judicial custody since 02.09.2025.
Heard the arguments.
Perused the grounds for grant of bail stated in the application, case diary and the relevant material on record.
Learned counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that the applicant is falsely implicated in the alleged offence.

Learned counsel referring to FIR at Crime No.231/2025 registered at P.S. Nagda submits that there was political discord NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:28221 2 MCRC-42202-2025 between the family members of complainant and the applicant.
Complainant Vinay Gurjar had called applicant Nitin @ Sunny to his home to discuss the matter, but Vinay Gurjar and his associates assaulted Nitin.
Later, false allegation of house trespass and threatening have been levelled against the applicant.

sentences.text: The P.S. Nagada had registered FIR at Crime No.232 of 2025 in this regard.
It is politically motivated allegation.
The applicant Nitin was arrested on 02.09.2025.
He is in custody ever since.
No incriminating material has been recovered and seized at the instance of the present applicant till date.
The investigation is underway.
Further custodial interrogation of the applicant is not needed in the matter.
There is no likelihood of tampering with evidence by the applicant.
Jail incarceration is causing hardship to the applicant and the dependent family.
Applicant is ready to cooperate in trial.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State ably assisted by learned counsel for the respondent/objector opposes the application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
Learned counsel refers to one criminal antecedent against the applicant, as mentioned in the case diary.

In reply, learned counsel for the applicant submits that the other matter relates to matrimonial discord of the applicant for offence punishable under section 498A of IPC wherein applicant has been extended benefit of bail and the same is pending for trial.
He has never been convicted.

According to the material available on case diary, Vinay Gurjar reported to P.S. Nagda, District Ujjain(M.P.) that he was at his home on NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:28221 3 MCRC-42202-2025 21.05.2025.
Applicant Nitin @ Sunny, his associate Aditya and two others
came to his house.
Applicant Nitin was armed with a gun.
He was dragged out of his house and manhandled.

P.S. Nagda registered FIR for offence punishable under Sections 296, 115(2), 351(2),
333, 308(2) and 3(5) of BNS, 2023.
Vinay Gurjar was forwarded for medico legal examination, but he declined to go for X-ray examination.
Later, prosecution for offence punishable under Section 331(6) was added.
Applicant was arrested on 02.09.2025.
He is in custody ever since.
Apparently, it is a case of altercation followed by manhandling between the members of two political groups over their discord relating to political issue.
Vinay Gurjar alleged that he was dragged out of his house and assaulted by the associates of the applicant, but no serious injury is revealed in the medical examination.
The veracity of prosecution will be determined after evidence in the trial.
As informed, the applicant is aged 37 years.
He is a contractor by profession and has the responsibility of his dependent family.
Considering these aspects, there appears to be no possibility of fleeing from justice.

In absence of substantial criminal past and previous conviction for any major offence, considering the socio-economic status of the applicant, there appears to be no likelihood of tampering with evidence or influencing the witnesses by the applicant.
There appears to be no compelling reason to continue incarceration of the applicant.
However, the observations, herein- above, are recorded for present application only.

Considering the rival contentions and overall circumstances of the case, in the light of aforestated facts, but without commenting on the merits, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:28221 4 MCRC-42202-2025 this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.
